transcript_correlations.comment: This video discusses how BetaFlights angle mode is not that great, but you can adjust it. He discusses how the angle mode produces a wobbling of the drone when it is stationary in the air. This is due to the slow responsiveness of the PID control of the drone. He also suggests going into the new code released from BetaFlight and adjusting certain parameters for a better experience in flight. After completing these enhancements of the drone, it will work better and can aid in your success as a drone flyer.
